invariants.description: wall thickness follows the Avolio/Blanco fit h = r0 (a e^{b r0} + c e^{d r0}) (relative 1e-9)
thin-wall tube stiffness K_tube = E h / ((1 − ν²) r0) (relative 1e-9)
stiffness and wall thickness are positive and h/r0 is between 0 and 0.5 (thin wall)

bc_sweep.rationale: Arterial radii 1-16 mm (small arteries to the aorta, ADAN range) and lengths 0.5-20 cm; E 0.05-2 MPa (identified value to above the ADAN elastin/large-artery range); nu 0.3-0.5; wall viscosity K_M 1e3-1e5 Pa s around Toro2022/Muller2023 (3-3.6e4) and smooth-muscle fractions 0.05-0.55 (Muller2023 weights 0.10-0.55); Olufsen-type k1 1e5-3e6 Pa, k2 -2500..-500 m^-1, k3 2e4-1e5 Pa spanning the Toro2022 and Olufsen2000 sets; rho 1040-1060 kg/m^3; tube-law exponents around m = 0.5, n = 0. The Avolio/Blanco thickness-fit coefficients are swept by factors 0.5-2.

baseline.reason: candidate: compare the implied wave speed c0 = sqrt(K_tube (m - n)/rho) with measured pulse wave velocities of named arteries vs radius (e.g. the Charlton2019 in-silico/in-vivo PWV database or Avolio1980 segment data); needs a network-level geometry table, not set up.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: algebraic constitutive relation with no dynamics; parameters are calibrated in the vessel network that uses it.
